## Description

Fade an opening price gap when historical behavior suggests the gap is likely to retrace.

## Where it may fit

Liquid securities with small, non-news gaps that revert toward prior close/VWAP.

## Vehicles

Liquid stocks and equity ETFs; selected futures.

## Required data

Daily close and next open, intraday bars, news/event flags, premarket quotes, spread and volume.

## Caveats

Large gaps caused by earnings or news may continue rather than fade; avoid look-ahead in event labels.
